name: EZ Bar Skullcrusher to Chin
description: A skullcrusher variation where the bar is lowered to the chin rather than the forehead. This version engages a greater range of elbow flexion and can feel more natural for many lifters. Lowering to the chin changes the angle of tricep loading through the range.

execution.starting_position: Set up for EZ Bar Skullcrusher to Chin in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for EZ Bar Skullcrusher to Chin.
steps: Step 1: Lie on bench with EZ bar held at arm's length above chest.
Step 2: Allow elbows to drift slightly back as you lower the bar.
Step 3: Lower bar to chin level, feeling tricep stretch.
Step 4: Extend elbows to full lockout at starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Lowering too far risking chin contact
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Control the arc, do not hit chin
